1014.description: A V-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1078.description: A glute bridge with heels in straps, which adds an instability challenge. It builds glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

1206.description: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

1270.description: Cable crossovers aimed at the upper chest. It trains the upper pecs.
instructions: Attach the handles to the cables at chest height.
Stand in the center of the cable machine with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing down and your arms extended out to the sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and engage your core.
Pull the cables together in front of your chest, crossing them over each other.
Squeeze your chest muscles at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the cables back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到胸部高度的电缆上。
站在绳索机的中央，一只脚稍微在另一只脚前面。
手掌朝下抓住手柄，手臂向两侧伸展。
保持肘部轻微弯曲并启动核心肌群。
将电缆在胸前拉到一起，使它们相互交叉。
在运动的最高点挤压胸部肌肉。
慢慢地将电缆释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1334.description: A stability ball back extension with your hands behind your head. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and upper back.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it with your hips resting on the ball.
Position your feet against a wall or other stable surface for support.
Cross your arms behind your head, with your hands touching the back of your head.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上。
将脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上以获得支撑。
双臂交叉于脑后，双手触碰后脑勺。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到臀部形成一条直线。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1398.description: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back with the heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other leg.
instructionsZh: 面朝墙壁或坚固物体站立，距离大约一臂远。
将手放在与肩同高的墙壁或物体上。
一只脚向后退一步，保持脚跟平放在地面上。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直。
您应该感觉到小腿肌肉有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
在另一条腿上重复。

1462.description: A full-depth barbell squat shown from the side. It builds the quads, glutes and core and shows your depth and back angle clearly.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你开始降低身体时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，向后和向下推臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

1526.description: A snatch lifted overhead with straight arms and no re-bend of the knees. It trains the upper pull and arm turnover.
instructions: Hold the bar at the hips with a wide grip, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull the bar up high with your elbows, turn it over and press to locked arms overhead without squatting.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1590.description: A lying hamstring curl on a machine using one leg at a time. It helps balance strength between legs.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine and place one leg under the pad above your heel.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

1654.description: A dumbbell curl using an overhand grip. It trains the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1718.description: A seated barbell triceps extension behind the neck with a close grip. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with a close grip behind your neck, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your head and slowly lower the barbell towards the back of your head.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧抓住颈后的杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近头部，慢慢将杠铃放低至脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1782.description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them stretches the chest and front of the shoulders. It is a classic posture reset.
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1910.description: Rest one heel on a raised surface and lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructions: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1974.description: Standing with your hands clasped behind you to open the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

2102.description: Pulls the toes back toward the shin while sitting, giving the calf and the back of the lower leg a gentle stretch.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

2166.description: A glute bridge held while you march your knees one at a time against a band, testing hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot off the floor, drawing the knee toward your chest.
Lower it and lift the other foot, keeping your hips level.
Continue alternating at a steady pace, then lower your hips.

2294.description: A seated zottman curl on a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and elbows resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary and your palms facing up.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部放在垫子上。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止，手掌朝上。
在弯举的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2358.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2742.description: A machine hip thrust with the feet raised on a step box, for a deeper glute contraction.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your feet on the step box and the pad across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

2806.description: A one leg deadlift with the rear foot resting on a step box for balance. Works hamstrings and glutes with less wobble.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell and rest the toes of one foot on a step box behind you.
Soften the front knee and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Keep your back flat and go as far as your hamstring allows.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

2870.description: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

2934.description: A one-arm kettlebell press from a half-kneeling stance. The position teaches hip stability while you press.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

2998.description: A gentle seated stretch for the front of the ankle and shin that eases stiffness after sitting or training.
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

3126.description: Pointing the foot against a band to strengthen the calf and ankle.
instructions: Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

3254.description: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

3318.description: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
启动你的核心并以圆周运动摆动你的手臂，同时旋转你的躯干。
继续圆周运动，摆动手臂并旋转躯干，达到所需的重复次数。
记住在整个练习过程中保持呼吸。

3382.description: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3510.description: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

3574.description: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

3638.description: A push-up that flows into fast alternating knee drives in the plank position. It raises the heart rate and trains the chest and core.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Quickly bring one knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring the other knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating knees as fast as you can while maintaining good form.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
用手推动以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
快速将一个膝盖靠近胸部，然后快速切换并将另一只膝盖靠近胸部。
继续尽可能快地交替膝盖，同时保持良好的姿势。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3702.description: A forward lunge held in the bottom position where you pulse up and down with your arms overhead. It burns the legs and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.

3830.description: Lying on your back, you loop a towel around your feet and curl it with a hammer grip. It trains your biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pushing your feet against it.
Pause, then slowly extend your arms.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

3894.description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees almost straight.
Hinge at the hips and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand, keeping your back flat.

3958.description: Walk your hands and feet sideways in a front plank to train the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand and foot out to the side.
Bring the other hand and foot to meet them.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat in one direction, then reverse.

4022.description: Seated crunch where the legs trace a figure eight in the air. It works the lower abs and hip flexors while you balance on your seat.
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and support yourself with your hands behind you.
Lift both feet off the floor and brace your core.
Draw a figure eight in the air with your legs, slow and controlled.
Keep your chest lifted and your lower back from collapsing.
Lower your feet and rest, then repeat.

4086.description: The classic standing curl with a band underfoot. It builds the biceps with smooth, rising resistance.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and grip the ends.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists neutral throughout.

4150.description: A single arm fly that sweeps the dumbbell from low up to the chest. It works the upper pecs and front shoulder.
instructions: Stand with feet staggered and hold a dumbbell at your side with a slight elbow bend.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sweep the dumbbell out and up in an arc to chest height in front of you.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly along the same arc.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4214.description: A plate-loaded machine row pulling from low to your torso. It builds the mid back and lats with a guided path.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet planted.
Grab both handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment at the end.
Let the arms extend slowly under control.
Do not lean back to move the weight.

4278.description: Gentle knee circles with the leg slightly bent that loosen up the knee area and calves. Handy as a warm-up or a loosening drill.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Place your hands on your knees for support.
Slowly rotate your knees in a circle in one direction.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Switch to the other direction after 8 to 10 circles.

4342.description: A dumbbell fly where you rotate your wrists through the movement for a stronger chest squeeze.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide in an arc with elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your wrists as you lower until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together, twisting them to finish with palms inward.
Control the weight on the way down.

4406.description: A hands-and-knees pose where one leg extends back and the spine arches, mobilising the back and hips.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Round your back and draw one knee toward your nose.
Then extend that leg back and up while lifting your chest.
Move smoothly with your breath.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

4470.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner thigh (adductors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inner thigh (adductors) while lying face down with your thigh turned out.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4534.description: Passing a kettlebell around your body in circles while standing. It works the shoulders, core and grip.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

4598.description: A foam roller release for the outer front hip, easing tightness around the tensor fasciae latae.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the front of your outer hip.
Support yourself with your forearm and opposite foot.
Slowly roll up and down a few inches.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Breathe slowly and keep the movement gentle.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

4726.description: A pull-up with a staggered, side-on grip that you pull to alternating sides of the bar. It builds lats, arms and grip.
instructions: Grab the bar with one hand in front of the other, palms facing each other, and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your body up, moving your head to one side of the bar.
Get your chin or shoulder level with the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
Switch which side your head passes on each rep, or each set.

4790.description: A one-legged squat down to a bench behind you. It builds leg strength and balance while the bench keeps the depth safe.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the working knee in line with your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4854.description: A seated twist with a barbell across your shoulders. It trains the obliques and core rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs bent and a bar across your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and brace.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.

4918.description: Springy hops from one foot to the other with a high knee. It raises your heart rate and trains leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
Hop off one foot and drive the opposite knee up.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Switch legs on the next hop.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep a quick, bouncy pace.

4982.description: The lowering half of the dragon flag. You control a straight body down toward the bench, which builds serious core strength.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight vertical line on your upper back.
Lower your body slowly as one stiff plank, keeping hips from bending.
Stop just above the bench with your core tight.
Bend your knees to return to the start, then repeat.

5046.description: Hold a V sit and reach to tap your toes. It strengthens the abs and challenges balance.
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back, lifting your legs into a V.
Reach both arms forward.
Crunch up and tap your toes with your fingers.
Lower slightly back while keeping your feet up.
Keep your chest open and repeat.

5110.description: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

5174.description: Small pulses in a wall push-up position. It keeps constant tension on your triceps.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, close together at chest height.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows slightly to bring your chest toward the wall.
Pulse in short, controlled movements.
Keep your elbows tucked and your core tight.

5238.description: A lunge combined with a medicine ball curl. It trains the legs and arms in one go.
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball at your thighs.
Step forward into a lunge.
Curl the ball up toward your chest as you lower.
Push back to standing while lowering the ball.
Alternate legs on each rep.

5302.description: Standing on a balance board to train stability. It strengthens the ankles and the small stabilisers in the feet.
instructions: Place the board on a flat, non-slip surface.
Step onto it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Tilt gently without letting the edges touch the floor.
Balance for 30-60 seconds.

5814.description: A standing cable press with the handles starting low and moving upward. It works the upper chest and front shoulders.
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
Return slowly to the start.

6006.description: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

6070.description: A curl with an overhand grip holding bottles. It trains the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

6262.description: A standing wrist curl holding a barbell behind or in front of you. It builds the forearm flexors.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Curl your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

6774.description: A seated stretch that opens the space between the shoulder blades. It relieves tightness in the upper back.
instructions: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat.

6902.description: A seated pose that stretches the shoulders, triceps and hips together.
instructions: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides and repeat.

7414.description: A crunch with your legs against a wall that keeps your hips steady and works the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

8374.description: A squat that steps one leg out to the side before returning. It works the legs and hips with a bit of lateral movement.
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

8502.description: A kneeling one-arm press where the opposite knee is down, adding core and hip stability to the shoulder work.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

9398.description: Standing at a machine, you bring your arms together in front of your chest. It isolates the chest.
instructions: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.

10038.description: Rotating a dumbbell so your palm turns up, working the muscles that twist the forearm.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

10294.description: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

10550.description: Press a plate out from your chest while lying on the floor, squeezing it with both hands. It targets the inner chest.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.

10742.description: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.

10870.description: A glute bridge held with a band while stepping sideways. It targets glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

10934.description: A side-lying outward shoulder rotation with no weight. It trains rotator cuff control.
instructions: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

10998.description: A wall-facing handstand with one leg split off the wall. It trains balance and shoulder endurance.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

11254.description: A standing cable reverse fly aimed at the rear shoulders and upper back. It helps balance all the pressing you do.
instructions: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the opposite handles, arms crossed.
Stand tall with soft elbows.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the crossed start.

0054.description: A walking-style lunge with the bar on the upper back. Works the glutes and quads, one leg at a time.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your right knee until your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持躯干直立。
弯曲右膝降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替腿进行所需的重复次数。

0118.description: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. Targets the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸，直到躯干几乎与地板平行。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0182.description: Biceps curl performed lying on a bench with a close grip on a low-pulley bar. Lying down keeps the tension on the biceps through the whole curl.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Lie face up on a flat bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the bar towards your chest by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面朝上躺在平坦的长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将杠铃卷向胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0246.description: An upright row using a cable. You pull the handle up toward the chin, leading with the elbows, to work the shoulders and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold the cable attachment with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the cable attachment straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the cable attachment back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，并用正手握住电缆附件。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
用肘部引导，将电缆附件笔直向上拉向下巴。
在顶部暂停片刻，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
缓慢地将电缆附件放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0310.description: A standing dumbbell front raise. You lift the weights to shoulder height to train the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向大腿。
保持双臂伸直，呼气并将哑铃举至身前，直至与肩齐平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0374.description: Chest down on an incline bench, you curl dumbbells from a hanging position. It stretches and works the biceps hard.
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 45-degree incline.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部和腹部靠在长凳上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0438.description: You press dumbbells overhead in a W-shaped path. It trains the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise them.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩高，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
将哑铃放低至肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0502.description: Lying on your back, you fold up to bring hands and feet together over your hips. It works the abs hard and builds hip flexor strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
Brace your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time, folding up at the hips.
Reach your hands toward your toes at the top.
Lower with control until arms and legs hover just above the floor.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

0630.description: From a high plank, you drive your knees toward your chest one after another. Works the core, shoulders and gets your heart rate up.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将你的右膝盖靠近你的胸部，然后快速切换并将你的左膝盖靠近你的胸部。
继续以跑步动作交替双腿，保持臀部较低，核心肌群参与。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏和均匀的呼吸。
重复所需的重复次数。

0694.description: Seated on a stability ball, you rotate your torso. It warms up the trunk and trains balance.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with feet flat.
Hold your arms in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Move slowly and controlled.

0758.description: On an incline bench, you press the smith machine bar with a reverse grip. Works the upper chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine to a comfortable incline angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip that is slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar is just above your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机的座椅调整到舒适的倾斜角度。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，同时保持肘部内收。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0822.description: A squat that adds a torso twist as you stand. It trains the legs and rotational control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands together at your chest.
Sit down into a squat.
As you stand, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre and squat again.
Alternate twisting sides.

0886.description: A single-leg deadlift using the smith bar. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand holding the bar at hip height on a single leg.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward, sliding the bar down your leg.
Keep your back flat and extend the free leg behind you.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

0950.description: Lie on your back and lift your chest into a gentle arch. It opens the chest and front of the neck and shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
